title: AshaDangerAlert
description: Versioned v1 safety-critical maternal or newborn danger-sign alert. Emitted immediately by Agent 1's deterministic engine independent of visit completion or confirmation. Clients MUST render urgently and MUST NOT suppress or downgrade alerts.

alert_id.description: Unique identifier for this danger-sign alert.

visit_id.description: Visit draft/record identifier associated with the alert.

beneficiary_id.description: Resolved synthetic beneficiary identifier, or null if danger sign was detected before beneficiary identification.

canonical_danger_sign_id.description: Stable machine-readable identifier mapped to an official NHM/MoHFW danger sign (e.g., newborn_chest_indrawing, anc_vaginal_bleeding).

canonical_name.description: Standardised clinical danger-sign label from official Indian public-health guidelines.

subject.description: Patient subject category affected by the danger sign.

category.description: Care phase category from NHM/MoHFW maternal and newborn guidelines.

supporting_evidence.description: Short matched phrase providing minimal clinical audit evidence. MUST NOT contain raw full audio or full conversation transcripts.

match_type.description: Deterministic matching mechanism that triggered this alert.

source_guideline_ref.description: Exact verified official Indian public-health guideline citation (document, section, page) from docs/DANGER_SIGN_GUIDELINES.md.

detected_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the danger sign was detected.

acknowledged_by.description: Synthetic identifier of the ASHA worker or supervisor who acknowledged the alert, or null.

acknowledged_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the alert was acknowledged, or null.

escalation_language.description: BCP-47 language tag used for the spoken urgent referral message (e.g., hi-IN, kn-IN, ta-IN, en-IN).

referral_message.description: Urgent referral guidance in escalation_language directing the worker to the nearest PHC immediately. Never contains a diagnosis, prescription, home remedy, or fabricated facility address/phone.

danger_sign_flagged.description: Always true on a verified danger alert.

examples.subject: newborn
examples.supporting_evidence: baby ka chest indrawing ho raha hai
examples.referral_message: Chetavni: Navjat shishu mein chest indrawing ek gambhir khatre ka lakshan hai. Kripya bachche ko turant nazdeeki PHC ya SNCU le jayein.

examples.subject: mother
examples.supporting_evidence: pregnancy mein bleeding ho rahi hai
examples.referral_message: Urgent alert: Vaginal bleeding during pregnancy is a danger sign. Please refer the mother to the nearest PHC immediately.
